availability_sli.numerator: bad events: beacon_http_requests_total{job="beacon"} with code 5xx on every route except /healthz and /metrics
availability_sli.denominator: eligible events: beacon_http_requests_total{job="beacon"} on every route except /healthz and /metrics, excluding 4xx
exclusions: /healthz and /metrics: probes and scrapes, not user requests
4xx client errors (400, 401, 404, 429): the caller's request was invalid or throttled by policy; tracked separately

latency_sli.numerator: eligible requests answered within 300 ms: beacon_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.3"} excluding /healthz and /metrics

decision: The budget is overspent (about 115%): freeze non-urgent releases, put the 503/504 sources on the reliability backlog first, and keep paging only on fast burn so on-call is not flooded.
